## Project Overview
My project is an investigation of the similarities and differences of how Black individuals are treated in the legal system. The current state of my project is preliminary, I am currently just gathering my ideas, datasets, and project inspiration. My current ideas on how to answer this question is by analyzing exoneration rates by state and race, mass incarceration by state and race, jim crow laws by state, federal sentencing to see if there’s a difference between sentencing by race by state, and traffic stops by race and state. I still don’t know how I want to present the data or what specific way to analyze this through, but I do think this is a good foundation for my research question.
